'''Alpha Premier''' was a [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] title. It was of unknown relation to the [[Uvena System Constabulary]]. [[Korta Sarc]] was an Alpha Premier until his death sometime before [[11 BBY/Legends|11 BBY]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
